title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer regional failover race (prevent thrash)
author: Laura Chen
description: Backport/hotfix to prevent a race between regional failover and SLO enforcer backoff that caused cascading load-shedding and repeated failovers under transient regional flaps. Root cause: the enforcer's regional decision path could concurrently trigger failover while an in-flight backoff timer was still active, resulting in duplicate rebalancing requests and priority-queue thrashing. This PR adds conservative deduplication and a short hysteresis window (250ms) around regional decision transitions, improves observability for failover decisions, and hardens the SLO enforcer state machine so backoff and failover are ordered deterministically. Includes unit + integration tests that simulate concurrent transitions and a small runtime guard to avoid double-scheduling reconfiguration during high churn. Related: ENG-3421 for long-lived solution and SUP-8812 customer incident report.
